name: Argon Electronics
summary: A single-shop electronics store dressed as a big white department store: a Deal of the Day strip, a photo hero by department, departments in two even rows, top deals by category, best sellers from the shop's tag, brands and guides; bordered product tiles with colour swatches that pick the colour; filters built from the products' own specs; a three-column product page with a sticky buy box, specs, reviews and bought-together; a side-by-side compare page; a receipt-first cart and a desk-style account.
